candidateRoutes.summary: Run the existing hardening workflow on a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner under the standing safety boundary.
candidateRoutes.command: GitHub Actions workflow Nightwatch hardening on a self-hosted runner at the exact candidate SHA
tradeOffs: Genuinely executes GitHub Actions at the exact head, so it is the only route that can satisfy exact-head CI authority
Requires provisioning and maintaining a persistent runner host with its own patching, isolation and credential posture
Runner identity and exact-head provenance must be bound and recorded, or the execution is not trustworthy evidence

candidateRoutes.summary: Execute gate:ci on a schedule from a disposable Node 20 checkout, with the same receipt discipline as CI, explicitly classified LOCAL_NOT_CI.
candidateRoutes.command: npm run gate:ci (Node 20, disposable checkout, scheduled)
tradeOffs: Executable today with no external dependency and no credential surface
Does not prove GitHub execution, billing unblocked, or runner topology; it is a local substitute and is classified as one
Depends on the owner host being available; a missed schedule produces no evidence rather than a false pass

candidateRoutes.summary: Accept the gate:topology lane as coverage of the runner-topology class specifically, with an explicit statement that it does not prove GitHub execution.
tradeOffs: Closes the two known host-topology defect classes locally and in any CI that executes
Does not execute on GitHub and cannot satisfy exact-head CI authority; CI_EXECUTED_SHA stays NONE
The block remains current, so the revisit condition and owner action stay load-bearing rather than being retired
